maddeler.e:
أنكرب (form VII)
# أَنْكَرِبُ (ʔankaribu) /ʔan.ka.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
# أَنْكَرِبَ (ʔankariba) /ʔan.ka.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
# أَنْكَرِبْ (ʔankarib) /ʔan.ka.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
